user.title: E-Wheels Charge Limiter
user.description: Pick the switch that cuts power to the charger, at least one meter on that plug, and the sensor that reports the battery's state of charge.

data_description.name: Used to name the entities, for example "Scooter Status".
data_description.plug_switch: The switch that cuts mains to the charger.
data_description.power_entity: Instantaneous power on that plug, in watts. Used to detect that charging has started, and to count energy if there is no energy sensor.
data_description.energy_entity: Cumulative energy on that plug. Preferred over the power sensor when both exist, because it is exact.
data_description.soc_entity: Battery percentage. Read just before a charge starts; it does not need to update during charging.
data_description.capacity_wh: Usable pack capacity. Only used to seed the estimate, which then corrects itself over the first few charges.
data_description.allow_foreign_meter: Tick only if the meter really does measure this charger, for example a separate clamp meter.

reconfigure.title: Change plug, meters or battery
reconfigure.description: Swap the plug, its meters or the battery on this limiter. Its entities, options and everything that points at them stay as they are.

data.forget_learning: Forget learned charges if the meter changes

data_description.plug_switch: The switch that cuts mains to the charger.
data_description.power_entity: Instantaneous power on that plug, in watts. Used to detect that charging has started, and to count energy if there is no energy sensor.
data_description.energy_entity: Cumulative energy on that plug. Preferred over the power sensor when both exist, because it is exact.
data_description.soc_entity: Battery percentage. Read just before a charge starts; it does not need to update during charging.
data_description.capacity_wh: Usable pack capacity. Only used to seed the estimate, which then corrects itself over the first few charges.
data_description.forget_learning: Recommended. What was learned is counted in the old meter's units, and a different meter rarely agrees with it. Only untick if you are correcting a mistake and the meter is really the same. Has no effect if the meters are unchanged.
data_description.allow_foreign_meter: Tick only if the meter really does measure this charger, for example a separate clamp meter.

error.no_meter: Pick a power sensor, an energy sensor, or both. Without a meter there is nothing to count.
error.meter_not_on_plug: That meter belongs to a different device than the switch, so it is probably not measuring the charger. Counting the wrong watt-hours would cut the charge at an arbitrary point. Pick a meter on the same plug, or tick the box below if you are sure.

abort.reconfigure_successful: Updated. The limiter has reloaded with the new settings.
abort.session_open: A charge is being counted right now. Wait until it has finished, or stop it, then try again - swapping meters mid-charge would count from the wrong starting point.

init.title: Options
init.description: Settings decide when a charge is cut and which battery readings it learns from. Vase values show the energy model behind the cut-off, and let you adjust or reset it.

menu_option_descriptions.settings: Target, charger detection, timings and the learning window.
menu_option_descriptions.vase: Wall Wh per percentage point for each 10-point band: what has been learned, typed starting points, and forgetting charges.

settings.title: Settings

data.soc_staleness_hours: Treat a reading as stale after (hours)
data.learn_window_hours: Learn from a charge for up to (hours)

data_description.target_soc: Where a charge stops. Below 100 % it is cut by the learned estimate. At 100 % there is no estimate: the charger ends the charge and the plug is switched off after the idle time below. Also adjustable from the Target charge entity.
data_description.rearm_hysteresis: How far below the target a new reading must be before the limiter arms for the next charge. Stops it re-arming on the small drop a pack shows as it settles.
data_description.charging_power_threshold: Power above this means the charger is charging; at or below it counts as quiet. Set it above what the charger draws when idle or finished.
data_description.idle_close_minutes: How long the power must stay quiet before a session counts as over. At a 100 % target or after Charge to full, this is how the end of the charge is detected and the plug cut.
data_description.max_session_hours: Safety cut-off: a session running longer than this is stopped and the plug switched off, whatever else is happening. Leave room for a full charge from empty.
data_description.soc_staleness_hours: How old a battery reading may be and still be trusted as the starting point of a charge. Older than this, the device may have been ridden since, so the charge runs without a limit and teaches nothing.
data_description.rest_minutes: A battery reads high straight after charging. Readings taken sooner than this after the plug is cut are shown but not learned from.
data_description.learn_window_hours: How long after the plug is cut a battery reading can still teach what that charge cost. A reading more than 15 points below where the charge should have ended is taken as ridden since and ignored.

settings.description:
Below a 100 % target, the limiter cuts the plug once the energy it has learned the remaining points cost has gone in. At 100 % it doesn't estimate: the charger ends the charge, and the plug is cut once it goes quiet.

It learns from a charge when the device reports its battery after the plug is cut - at rest, so no sooner than the rest time, and before it is ridden, within the learning window. Switching the device on near its Bluetooth link is enough.

vase.title: Vase values
vase.description:
Wall watt-hours needed per reported percentage point, for each 10-point band. A typed value is that band's starting point; learning keeps refining it from remembered charges. Leave a band blank to use the default.

Learned now: {learned}

data_description.forget_charges: Drops every remembered charge, so the bands fall back to their starting points. Use it if a charge taught something wrong.
data_description.band_0: Starting point for this band, in wall Wh per reported point. Leave blank to start from the default; learning refines it either way.

record_charge.name: Record a charge
record_charge.description: Remember a charge for the vase fit: where it started, where it settled, and how many wall watt-hours it took. The bands are refitted straight away.

config_entry_id.name: Charge limiter
config_entry_id.description: Which configured plug the charge belongs to.
